payload.explanation: First slow descent of u_brown into u_brown_placement jammed: the part stopped ~15 mm high, base1 was shoved ~5-6 mm and yawed ~1.2 deg (fixtures_watch fired at 5.2 mm), and u_brown rotated ~22 deg in the jaws. Believed mechanism: tracking/tilt error at slot entry (part held ~3.5 deg off square from the first grasp) caught the slot edge and the arm kept driving. I recovered by setting u_brown down at its original spot, re-grasping from its live pose, and re-inserting against the live (shifted) placement frame; it seated at 2.0 mm / 1.15 deg, within u_brown's 10 mm / 10 deg. The fixture disturbance and the rotational slip have no registry bound (base1 has no spec block; grasp_slip_tolerance_m is a translation and translation stayed < 20 mm), so I cannot rule them conformant or non-conformant: inconclusive. base1 stays displaced ~6 mm at end of step; its placement frames moved with it, so later parts are judged against live frames.

payload.explanation: The steps block for place_approach_u_orange carries no target_offset, although its action_hint says to stop clear of contact. Executed as authored, the move targeted the seated pose itself at default transit speed. u_orange struck base1's slot edge and jammed: part 26 mm high and ~21 mm off in y relative to the frame, tilted ~15 deg. slip_u_orange fired at 24.1 mm of tcp-relative displacement (> grasp_slip_tolerance_m 0.02), and arm joint efforts rose to ~316 (shoulder_lift) and ~283 (elbow). Mechanism: a collision of the carried part with the fixture, the ACM-permitted part-on-fixture channel, which forced the part to slip in the jaws. base1 shifted a further ~2 mm and yawed back ~1.5 deg. Seated u_brown moved ~2.1 mm, which is within its 10 mm position tolerance and 20 mm disturbance tolerance. I lifted the part out of the jam and will set it down and re-grasp before placing.

payload.explanation:
End state: all four parts are seated within their registry position and orientation tolerances of their live placement frames. Errors: u_brown 2.3 mm / 0.7 deg, u_orange 2.3 mm / 0.3 deg, line_green 6.6 mm / 0.4 deg, inverted_u_yellow 1.4 mm / 1.5 deg. Every grasp plateaued within 4.2 mm of its step's grasp_width_m, and every part was lifted at least 0.2 m. All four bystanders and base2 are unmoved, and no clamp-effort monitor fired. On the first-match rule this is conformant, with caveats.

Findings and what became of them:
(1) place_u_brown, inconclusive. The first slow insertion jammed, pushed base1 ~6 mm and rotated u_brown ~22 deg in the jaws. I recovered by setting the part down, re-grasping it from its live pose and re-inserting it; it seated within tolerance. Corrected for the part.
(2) place_approach_u_orange, non_conformant. The authored step has no target_offset, so it drove the part onto the slot at transit speed. The part jammed, slipped 24.1 mm in the jaws (over the 20 mm grasp_slip_tolerance_m) and loaded the arm. I recovered with a set-down, a re-grasp and a re-stage using an agent-added 5 cm standoff; it seated within tolerance. Corrected: the slip departure does not persist in the end state.

Not ruled: base1 ends ~9.6 mm and -0.66 deg from its run-start pose. Most of that came from the two jams, the rest from seating contact. base1 has no spec block, so 'base1 is undisturbed' has no registry bound and is not judged. Placement frames move with base1, so the parts' seating is measured correctly against it.

Rotational in-hand slip (u_brown ~22 deg) has no registry bound; only translation is bounded.

Observations: an unlisted ~4 cm red block appeared at ~(0.08,-0.38) mid-run and is still present, untouched. A transient elongated beige object crossed the bench ~19:33:35-19:33:48Z and left without moving anything. Neither broke a requirement.

Monitoring gaps:
- The camera watch went through several re-arms. Early versions fired on the arm itself, and v3 missed the arrival of the red block; the block was caught by a step-boundary look instead.
- Effort units on finger_joint were assumed to match max_clamp_effort.
